senses.gloss: (sec. r. of קס, v. קסס) [to cut,] (cmp. גזר) to decree; to fine, punish.
units: <cite ref="Bava Batra 75b:1">B. Bath. 75ᵇ</cite> top <he>קָנַסְתִּי מיתה על וכ׳</he> I decreed death over Adam.
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 18:4">Num. R. s. 18</cite> <he>אין קוֹנְסִים אלא וכ׳</he> none are punished below twenty years of age, v. <cite ref="P01016"><he>עָנַשׁ</he></cite>.
Gen. R. s. 20, beg. למה הייתם קוֹנְסִין את בני why did you fine (confiscate the property of) my children?; Yalk. Ps. 888; a. fr.—Esp. to decree a penalty beyond the strict law.

<cite ref="Bava Metzia 72a">B. Mets. 72ᵃ</cite>, a. e. <he>שטר … קונסין אותו וכ׳</he> if interest is stipulated in a document, we fine him (the creditor) so that he cannot collect either the principal or the interest.
<cite ref="Bava Kamma 30b:19">B. Kam. 30ᵇ</cite> <he>קָנְסוּ גופן משום שבחן</he> they decreed the forfeiture of the objects themselves on account of the illegitimate gain intended.
<cite ref="Shabbat 3b:12">Sabb. 3ᵇ</cite>, a. e. <he>קָנְסוּ שוגג אטו וכ׳</he>, v. <cite ref="A01073"><he>אָטוּ</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Bava Kamma 38b:14">B. Kam. 38ᵇ</cite> <he>קנס הוא שקנס וכ׳</he> (not <he>שקניס</he>) R. M. put a penalty on their property (declared their goods eventually unclean).
<cite ref="Bava Kamma 38b:15">Ib.</cite> <he>הכי נמי נִקְנוֹס</he> let us also fine (the Samaritan woman, by disallowing her the fine due for seduction).
<cite ref="Yevamot 86b:4">Yeb. 86ᵇ</cite> <he>קנסו לוים במעשר</he> they punished the Levites by depriving them of the tithes (in favor of the priests); a. fr.
<cite ref="Eruvin 18b:11">Erub. 18ᵇ</cite> <he>כיון שראה שנִקְנְסָה מיתה וכ׳</he> when he (Adam) perceived that through his fault death was decreed (over the human race), he fasted &c.
